_notes: Self-contained: the Activity's get_user/deliver_email are in-file mocks, no external APIs. Uses Standalone Activities (client.execute_activity with no Workflow), which need the Python SDK >= 1.33.0 (pinned). The guide states Temporal Server >= 1.32.0, but this passes on the dev server bundled with Temporal CLI 1.8.2 (Server 1.31.2). Driver is execute_activity.py (the plain .get() equivalent); it prints 'Result: sent to user42@example.com' from the mock, proving the Activity ran end to end on a Worker. comment-header mode naturally ignores the later '# execute_activity.py (updated)' and '# my_activity.py (excerpt)' blocks because their headers are not bare filenames, so the first full version of each file wins. Pinned to comment-header rather than the concat-header default: this published guide isn't in Code Sandwich form, and concat-header would read those '(updated)'/'(excerpt)' variants as header-less blocks and append them into the files. Drop the pin once the guide is rewritten in Code Sandwich form.
